Name: Malchiah, Son of Ethni
Summary: Son of Ethni and father of Baaseiah in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:40: Son of Ethni and father of Baaseiah in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Malchiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
